attestations.text: YANG Yü-ch'un 楊遇春 (T. 時齋), Jan. 19, 1762–1837, Apr. 3, general, the first Marquis Chao-yung (昭勇侯), was a native of Ch'ung-ch'ing, Szechwan, west of Chengtu. Becoming a military chü-jên in 1779, he started his career in 1780 as a non-commissioned officer in a battalion under the command of the governor-general of Szechwan.
楊遇春，字時齋，四川崇慶人。

accounts.evidence: 楊遇春，字時齋，四川崇慶人。以武舉效用督標，為福康安所識拔。從征甘肅石峰堡、台灣、廓爾喀，咸有功，累擢守備。
